name: GitHub
description: Read issues and pull requests through an HTTP MCP server you run. Opening a pull request still waits for a person. Merging stays with a person.

skills.name: Work a GitHub issue
skills.whenToUse: A GitHub issue should become a reviewed local change.
skills.body:
1. Read the issue.
2. Draft a plan and wait for approval.
3. Do not merge.

secrets.name: github-token
secrets.label: GitHub token from the operator's own account

name: Slack drafts
description: Draft a Slack reply with the bot token already saved in Settings. A person still decides before anything leaves this machine. This plugin adds no send tool.

skills.name: Draft a Slack reply
skills.whenToUse: A Slack reply should stay a draft until a person allows it.

2. Leave it as a draft.
3. A person uses the channel Allow path. This skill does not send.

name: Google
description: Use the Google account connected in Accounts. Gmail drafts stay drafts. A person sends from the draft card. A send scope is not requested.

skills.name: Use the connected Google account
skills.whenToUse: A task needs the Google account the operator connected in Accounts.
skills.body:
1. Use the Google account the operator connected in Accounts.
2. Gmail writes stay draft cards.
3. Do not request a send scope.
4. Stop for approval before creating a calendar event.
